note: An aura that reserves mana and quickens attacks, casting and movement (the allies' share is dropped).

def.name: Quickening Halo
def.description: Quickens your attacks, casting and movement.

note: An aura that reserves mana and gives accuracy and critical strike chance.

def.name: Keen Halo
def.description: Gives accuracy and critical strike chance.

note: An aura that reserves mana: the character's physical damage rises (the enemies' vulnerability near the character is folded into more damage).
An aura that reserves mana and gives resistance to all elements.
An aura that reserves mana and gives fire resistance and maximum fire resistance.

def.name: Ember Ward
def.description: Gives fire resistance and raises its maximum.

note: An aura that reserves mana and gives cold resistance and maximum cold resistance.

def.name: Frost Ward
def.description: Gives cold resistance and raises its maximum.

note: An aura that reserves mana and gives lightning resistance and maximum lightning resistance.

def.name: Storm Ward
def.description: Gives lightning resistance and raises its maximum.

note: An aura that reserves mana and regenerates life.

def.name: Vital Halo
def.description: Regenerates a share of your life every second.

note: An aura that reserves mana: more spell damage and critical strike chance (the consecrated ground is dropped).

def.name: Fervent Halo
def.description: Your spells hit harder and crit more.

note: An aura that reserves mana: more damage over time and longer ailments.

def.name: Malice Halo
def.description: Your damage over time is greater and lasts longer.

note: A stance that holds a tenth of the mana. In the Blood stance melee skills deal more area damage over less area; in the Sand stance they have more area and deal less damage in it. The character swaps stance by policy: the Sand stance when three or more enemies are near, the Blood stance otherwise; the stance is shared with Flesh and Stone and read by Bladestorm.

def.name: Dune Stance
def.description: Two stances: one makes your melee area skills hit harder over less ground, the other over more ground and softer.

note: A stance that holds a quarter of the mana. In the Blood stance the enemies near are maimed, and a maimed enemy takes more physical damage; in the Sand stance they are blinded, and the character takes less damage from the attacks of enemies that are not near. Swapped by policy with Blood and Sand.

def.name: Stone Stance
def.description: Two stances: enemies near you are maimed and weakened, or blinded while the attacks of those farther off do less to you.

note: A coat of frost: while the character stands still, hits do 8-13% less physical and 8-12% less fire damage; enemies that hit it are chilled for half a second, and while it moves it leaves chilled ground behind.

def.name: Rimeplate
def.description: A coat of frost: less physical and fire damage from hits while you stand still, a chill on what hits you, and a chilled trail where you walk.

note: A burning aura with no reservation: the enemies near burn for a fifth of the character's life a second; the character burns for nine tenths of its life a second as fire damage that its fire resistance and energy shield answer to, and never dies of it; more spell damage.

def.name: Searing Mantle
def.description: A mantle of fire that burns you and the enemies near.

note: An aura that reserves mana: physical damage gained as fire, and any enemy you kill sets the enemies near its corpse burning for a quarter of the damage the blow had left over each second, for four seconds.

def.name: Cinder Herald
def.description: Physical damage gained as fire, and a kill sets the enemies near the corpse burning for the damage it had to spare.

note: An aura that reserves mana: added cold damage, and frozen enemies shatter in an icy burst when killed.

def.name: Rime Herald
def.description: Added cold damage, and frozen enemies shatter in an icy burst.

note: An aura that reserves mana: added lightning damage, and killing a shocked enemy calls down bolts on the enemies around the character for six seconds.

def.name: Storm Herald
def.description: Added lightning damage, and killing a shocked enemy calls down bolts around you for a while.

note: Poison chance and more poison damage; each poison the character puts on an enemy gives a point of Virulence (up to 40, lost faster the more is held) and calls a crawler that cannot be hurt and grows stronger and quicker with it; with no Virulence left, the crawler is gone.

def.name: Sour Herald
def.description: Poisons call a crawler whose strength follows your Virulence.

note: A strike that also calls lightning down about the enemy it struck (the enemy itself is not hit again); a hit gives the character an aura for four seconds that adds lightning to its hits and a chance to shock.

def.name: Thunder Rebuke
def.description: A strike that calls lightning down about its target, and lights you with a crackling aura.
